rationale: The stock has already dropped roughly 6.5% from prior close on a negative earnings miss (revenue and EPS both below estimates, Cross-Border Payments segment declining YoY), and is sitting near the low end of today's range at 17.8% with price consolidating tightly in a narrow band around $59.66. With 85 minutes to close, the move is largely exhausted and price action shows very low momentum (last 5 candles are nearly flat with declining volume), making it difficult to identify a high-conviction directional edge — a short risks a dead-cat bounce while a long faces continued selling pressure from the fundamental catalyst. The wide spread (20 bps) on a volatile name with an already-realized large gap adds friction that reduces expected value on either side.
